content:
Apple TV has released the trailer for the second season of its German-language dark comedy Where's Wanda? today, with the show returning to the platform on October 21. Watch the trailer below.

Where's Wanda? returns on October 21

Nearly two years ago, Where's Wanda? premiered on Apple TV, telling the story of the Klatt family searching high and low for their missing daughter—the Wanda of the title.

After growing deeply frustrated with the police's search efforts, the Klatt family decided to take matters into their own hands, gradually unearthing the dark secrets of their neighbours along the way.

Where's Wanda? season one ran for eight episodes. The show returns on October 22 for another eight-episode run, with new episodes dropping weekly on Wednesdays through December 10.
